threat_actor: Unattributed (Microsoft has not attributed this activity to a named threat actor)
summary: Phishing campaigns delivered a legitimate, digitally signed MSP360 RMM v2.5.0.67 installer under deceptive business-document filenames; after UAC elevation it installed MSP360 services and registry autostart entries for persistent remote access. The RMM agent then launched PowerShell to download and silently install ConnectWise ScreenConnect (ClientSetup.msi via msiexec /qn) as a redundant remote-access channel used to stage and run credential-access and collection utilities. Detection can focus on unusual RMM service installation, PowerShell spawned by RMM.Agent.exe, msiexec silent MSI installs, and ScreenConnect clients contacting non-approved infrastructure.
